name: Smoke Bomb
effect:
Create a 4 tile radius cloud of smoke obscuring creatures inside.
The smoke lasts an amount of around equal to your INT + 1
When you craft Smoke Bombs you get 3
upgrade:
The radius of smoke clouds increases to 6
Additionally you get 5 smoke bombs

name: Grappling Hook
effect:
Move to a location at higher elevation within 5 tiles. 
Opportunity attacks have disadvantage on this movement. 
After using your Grappling Hook you must reel it in as an action before you can use it again.
upgrade:
You may attempt to pull a medium or smaller creature within 5 tiles to you with your grappling hook. 
It makes a Reflex or Fortitude saving throw against your Crafting or Athletics, being pulled on a failure.
On a critical failure you may also grapple or knock the creature prone.

name: Runic Detector
effect:
Throw a tiny device that detects any Wards or Runes within 10 tiles 
The device has 4 health
If recovered the Runic Detector can be used up to three times per day

name: Flashbang
effect:
Throw a device to create a burst of light in a 3 tile radius area.
Creatures inside need to make a Fortitude save.
 Success: Target is dazzled for one turn.
 Failure: Target is blinded for one turn and dazzled for one minute 
 Critical Failure: Target is blinded for one minute
While affected by this, the creatures can spend one action to attempt to redo the save, removing the remaining effects on a success.

name: Spark Bomb
effect:
Throw a device to create a burst of electricity in a 2 tile radius area.
Creatures inside need to make a basic Reflex saving throw or take 1d12 lightning damage
Creatures that fail their save are also stunned 1.
Creatures wearing metal armor have -2 to their save.

name: Mana Dampener
effect:
Throw a small device that projects a 6 tile radius area that disrupts spellshaping
The device has 4 health.
All spellshaping checks in the area have a -3 penalty in the area.
The area lasts for a minute or until the device is destroyed
upgrade:
With some complex tinkering, your Mana Dampener now works based on mana signatures allowing it to not affect you and your allies.
You and allies you select when you craft it are not affected.
Additionally have made it sturdier, it now has 10 health.

name: Boots of Jumping
effect:
When you Leap or High Jump you jump an addtional 3 tiles.
Additionally when calculating fall damage from that jump, reduce the fall distance by 5. 
You can use Boots of Jumping 3 times per day
upgrade:
When you use your Boots of Jumping you can spend an extra charge to stay in the air. 
At the end your turn you fall 10 tiles, taking no fall damage, and landing standing.
If you are still in the air at the start of your next turn you fall as normal.

name: Manasight Goggles
effect:
You have advantage on Mana Sensing and Identify Spell checks until the start of next turn. 
You can use Manasight Goggles 3 times per day
upgrade: When using your Manasight Goggles you instead get truesight for the duration

name: Silence Emitter
effect:
Throw a tiny device that projects a 6 tile radius area within where no sounds can be heard.
The device has 4 health
The area lasts for a minute or until the device is destroyed
upgrade: Increase the radius to 10 tiles, and health to 12.

name: Lightning Grounder
effect:
Throw a small device that projects a 6 tile radius within that arcs lightning into it.
The device has 10 health and has resistance 20 to lightning damage.
When spell or effect would deal lightning damage in the area, make a gadget check with a +5 bonus against it.
On a success the device absorbs the lightning damage no other targets in the area are affected.
upgrade:
Increase the radius to 10 tiles, and health to 18.
Increase the lightning resistance to 30 and gadget check bonus +8

name: Orb of Unweaving
effect:
Throw a specially designed bomb that does no damage but attempts to disrupt a nearby spell effect.
The Orb can target a spell effect such as a Water Ball or effects on a creature. 
If it targets a creature, the creature gets to first make a Reflex save
Then make a Gadget roll against the Will Save of the caster of the spell, ending the spell on a success

name: Teleportation Ward Device
effect:
Throw a small teleportation ward that projects a 8x8 tile area that blocks teleportation effects
The device has 6 health
When any creature would teleport inside or into the area, make a gadget check with a +5 bonus against them
On a success the device blocks the teleportation

name: Miniature Teleportation Beacon
effect:
Throw a tiny teleportation beacon, that focuses teleportation magic.
You and allies you select when you craft it have a +5 bonus on spellshaping checks to teleport to beacon.
Additionally when you attempt to teleport to the beacon, you may teleport twice the distance specified by the spell.
